role: Exploratory prerequisite screen for a nondegenerate private-error information calculation; not a second-public-law, risk or JIT-benefit study
question: Does any previously enumerated shortest homologically trivial red-edge cycle produce a second private initial error with the exact same positive full first public record as the J7M fixture?
program_alignment: Tests whether an ideal D4 public record can be evaluated under two genuinely alternative hidden errors, prerequisite to asking whether action-conditioned charge observations carry private-error information.
research_basis: Jing Appendix A/C ideal red-X and first fusion-charge rules through the validated R6AF public-interface contract
J7L exhaustive 12 shortest homologically trivial simple cycles
J7M fixed positive full first public record and two equal-flux public actions
J7R finding that one fixed initial error cannot identify information or risk

model.geometry_and_state: Paper-normalized periodic L=2 D4 honeycomb with 36 red-X edges and the J6M anyon-free vacuum orbit; p_Z=0.
model.physical_prior: IID Bernoulli red-X on all 36 edges at p_X=1/10, reusing a frozen Lab 004 exact semantic-fixture rate. Positive-prior eligibility holds for any 0<p_X<1. If a pair is found, report weights only after restricting this IID prior to those two specific supports and conditioning on the selected first record; this is not the full-channel posterior.
model.first_public_observation: The exact J7M full 24-site binary charge/flux/vacuum first record, all first charges zero, of mass 1/4 under initial physical error [0,4,3]. Physical support and operator relations remain private.
model.actions: The J7M relation-free public red-X corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] remain frozen and are not evaluated in this preflight. Both are selected after the same public first record; second measurements remain action-conditioned and uncomputed.
model.candidate_construction: XOR the private initial error [0,4,3] with each of all 12 J7L shortest homologically trivial six-edge simple cycles. This preserves first flux. For each candidate, test whether the selected complete first public record has positive exact ideal Born mass; do not select a candidate based on a later second-law or information outcome.
model.independent_unit_uncertainty: Finite deterministic exact rational first-record mass for each enumerated candidate; no stochastic independent unit or interval. A future stochastic risk study has not been designed here.

matrix.candidate_cycles: All 12 distinct simple six-red-edge homologically trivial cycles in the pinned J7L rows, sorted lexicographically; no post-result omission
matrix.selection_rule: If the entire matrix finishes within bounds, select the lexicographically first candidate with positive selected-first-record mass; otherwise select none and report censoring. This is an exploratory feasibility choice, not confirmatory evidence of an information effect.
two_branches: A structural first-flux and exact first-record positivity gate for every shortest-cycle alternative initial error
A restricted-pair IID-prior weight calculation for the selected candidate only, contingent on a complete positive screen
matrix.risk_dependency: Unconditional full-channel logical risk is not evaluated. It separately requires all attempted physical histories or a bounded-tail ensemble, matched keys, private Boolean-union score and denominator; the J6 phenomenological cohort is not transferable.

acceptance: All nine source/result pins and runner SHA match before and after
Original physical error replays the exact first public mass 1/4 and the same 24-site flux
Every one of the 12 pinned shortest cycles is tested or the matrix is explicitly censored at a registered resource gate; no candidate is silently skipped
For a selected pair, both errors have positive exact mass for the identical full first public record and positive restricted IID posterior weights
No complete second law, mutual information, logical risk, noisy schedule, policy emission or threshold is claimed

outcomes.candidate_found: Register a separate bounded matched two-error complete-second-law information study; current result is first-record feasibility only.
outcomes.none_positive: The shortest-cycle class fails the same-first-record gate; do not infer no pair exists among longer cycles or other error supports.
outcomes.censored: Pin, geometry, variable-site, term or CPU gate fires; preserve the partial matrix and do not raise bounds after observing outputs.

stop_rule: Stop after the 12 fixed candidates or at the first term/CPU censor. No adaptive cycle class, expanded term ceiling, second/next law, physical-history sampling or risk comparison in this tick.
